example_line: org prompt "... The chart on the ear is kept in folder 6. ... The chart on the wrist is kept in folder 9. ... The chart on the skull is kept in folder 5. ... In which folder is the chart on the body part joining hand and arm?" -> answer org 9; the alt prompt asks about the skull (bridge alt), its 1st statement. Possible answers after the patch: 5 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 6 (answer at the same statement slot), 4 (the alt prompt's own answer), 9 (answer org kept).
